```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
dplyr::glimpse(listings)
```

## Task 1
```{r}
# count listings per host_id and join to listings
host_counts = listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "listing_count")

listings = listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

# report how many hosts have more than 10 listings and what percent of chicagos listings these hosts hold
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(listing_count >= 10) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    hosts_10_plus = dplyr::n_distinct(host_id),
    chicago_percent = sum(city == "Chicago") /
                      sum(listings$city == "Chicago") * 100
  )

```
